newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil dragged higher by futures, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil dragged higher by futures, trade quiet.

text.p: NWE gas oil edged higher on Monday in line with benchmark IPE gas oil futures but activity on the physical market remained minimal, traders said.
July IPE gas oil was trading $2.0 higher at $160.50 a tonne at 1257 GMT.
The heating oil market was extremely quiet with premiums quoted at around July IPE -50 cents/flat fob ARA for remainder of June as well as first half July delivery.
Low sulphur premiums were also little changed at around July IPE +$4.50/+$5.50 fob ARA.
EN590 cargo levels were quoted around July IPE +$5.0/+$6.0 cif NWE. Traders said the low sulphur market remained amply supplied.

They said while less Mediterranean material was expected to head for northern Europe in July the return to production after maintenance by a handful of northern refiners at the end of June would keep supplies healthy.

Russian material was also seen as well-supplied. Premiums for Russian material were talked around the $1.0/flat cif NWE for 0.2 percent gas oil. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714 Latest physical gas oil prices double click on 0#GO-
